description: Enjoy the ultimate Fishdom experience - it's better than ever! Now all your fish are in 3D and have their own personalities. Feed them, play with them, and watch them interact with each other. Engage in challenging and fun match-3 gameplay with new unique twists. - Earn dozens of awards and achievements. - Choose from over 150 underwater decor items and accessories. - 8 unique themes. - Design as many tanks as you like. Hey, your finned friends are waiting for you - dive in!
